orchestrator.note: Cost choice: Sol is Codex's recommended default and about 5x cheaper per token than Astra; Astra keeps stage acceptance and Enhanced.

escalateTo.when: the question needs judgment, not search

worker.effortRule: medium for blocks with a settled contract and clear shape; high for debugging, unclear failures, and non-trivial implementation

auditor.game: Round 1 runs every lens. Auditors report everything; the cooperator takes only real findings. A lens with real findings won the round: the same worker fixes, and only winning lenses play the next round. A lens with nothing real lost and is retired for this block. The block passes when every lens has lost or after the last round.

escalation.requires: Rare exception only: state a concrete unresolved reasoning problem, why medium/high is insufficient, and the expected benefit. Never use xhigh/max by default for implementation or review, or solely because a task is large, important, or a prior attempt failed. Respect user budget and effort limits.

selectionRules.reuse: Explicit task or launch choice, active task context, or applicable standing preference.
selectionRules.autonomous: Choose Standard for clear solutions or Enhanced for substantial unresolved design; proceed without asking. Applies to unattended execution too.
selectionRules.askOnly: Long-running multi-stage work with substantial unresolved solution choices and material approach/resource impact, with no applicable choice or delegated selection.
selectionRules.runtimeMismatch: Adapt to available settings even for a user-selected preset without a new approval gate. Report material actual routing honestly; separately explicit strict model/effort/budget requirements remain binding.

profileSemantics: Optional, non-exhaustive recommendations. A named choice expresses approach preference, not strict model/effort/team requirements. Custom or unnamed routing is allowed; separately explicit constraints remain binding.

gpt-6-astra.role: most capable; stage acceptance, Enhanced brain, bounded open design

gpt-6.1-sol.role: near-Astra for complex work at Sol price; Standard brain, implementation, block review

gpt-6-sol.status: still served; superseded by gpt-6.1-sol in this policy

gpt-6-luna.role: read-only lookups, mechanical checks, audit lenses at xhigh
gpt-6-luna.effortUpTo: xhigh (max on the API; no ultra)

modelResolution.note: Codex efforts: Astra light by default; Sol and Luna medium by default; ultra enables Codex-native subagents. Config values are low|medium|high|xhigh|max|ultra.

workClasses.direct: Question, analysis, config or doc edit, trivial fix. The cooperator does it inline; no agents.
workClasses.build: Bug fix or feature with a known shape. One worker block; audit and review at the cooperator's choice.
workClasses.pipeline: Multi-stage or design-open work. Plan of N blocks with disjoint write sets; stage acceptance at the end.

judging.real: In the diff or caused by it; breaks a named rule, document, or acceptance line; reproduces by a check or a concrete scenario.
judging.notReal: Theoretical risk, hypothetical input, work outside SCOPE, taste without a rule, duplicate of a rejected finding.
judging.who: The cooperator (orchestrator) judges; auditors and reviewers report everything.

continuity: Fixes go back to the same worker, the next audit round only to the auditors whose lens won the last round, the delta to the same reviewer, through followup_task. A fresh agent is for independence or a different model.
